_note: Where the mountain (tools/scenery/mountain.py) stands in each area's sky. yaw: degrees round from north, east positive. scale: 1 is the view from town, bigger is nearer. lift: degrees raised above the horizon. An area not listed uses the default.
_valley: The valley below the Lookoff (tools/scenery/valley.py, decision 0425): painted only in the areas listed. yaw: degrees round from north that the view's middle faces (180 is south). scale and lift as the mountain's. fogFloor: the lowest height the dawn fog thickens down to there (elsewhere -4), so the drop below the lip doesn't fill with a white bank in front of the painting.
